attributes.name: repeating_traits_-NIHPukWo4uOLpvaCLFy_description
attributes.current:
When you summon your echo, You can roll a number of hit dice. The echo gains Max hp equal to 2*con + value rolled. 

It is resistant to all damage except force. If you receive psychic damage, it receives half of it. 

The echo counts as a creature that shares your initiative count and can move and act at will during your initiative. It has no bonus actions. 

Instead of using the unleash incarnation feature, the echo may use it's action to make an attack. 

It receives all your class features except for multiattack and echo knight features. 

Instead of using your bonus action to move it, You simply use it's movement.
